name: Idleness
overview: Scripture warns against idleness by urging believers to learn diligence from the ant and to avoid excessive sleep or slumber that leads to poverty and want. The Proverbs passages highlight the consequences of laziness, showing that a slack hand results in poverty, while diligent hands bring prosperity. Furthermore, wisdom is demonstrated by timely labor, such as gathering during the harvest, whereas sleeping through opportunities brings shame. These verses collectively call Christians to active, disciplined stewardship of their time and resources as an expression of godly wisdom.
